title: The daughter Edward Kenway never knew in Black Flag
subject: edward
description:
Should Edward ever have left Bristol? 👇

The news that reached Edward Kenway in 1722, and the daughter he met at Great Inagua. Spoilers for Assassin's Creed IV: Black Flag.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Ubisoft. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Edward Kenway learned in 1722 that his wife was already dead.
Caroline Scott had died in 1720, at her parents' house on Hawkins Lane in Bristol.
She was sick for months, and her father did little to help.
A year earlier, in a fever, he'd seen her in a vision: "You left! When I needed you the most."
Caroline had been pregnant when his ship left England.
In 1722 their daughter, Jennifer, came to his fortress at Great Inagua.
She kept her mother's surname, Scott, and Edward let her keep it.
